subject.title: feat: Registry-safe Commerce admin with native continuity

question: Should the registry-safe sandbox admin remain the pilot delivery path once the explicit-status compatibility repair and inspectable runtime proof are supplied?
rationale: This PR introduces a new distribution and admin interaction model alongside the native compatibility contract; that product boundary needs an explicit owner decision after the concrete defect is resolved.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded sandbox pilot
options.body: Accept the documented sandbox-admin direction after the status-intent repair and real runtime proof demonstrate that existing sellability semantics remain intact.

options.title: Retain native-only administration
options.body: Do not adopt the sandbox delivery path now, leaving the existing native compatibility surface as the pilot entry point.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded sandbox pilot
recommendation.body: Accept the documented sandbox-admin direction after the status-intent repair and real runtime proof demonstrate that existing sellability semantics remain intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and PR context identify this contributor as the active owner of both the sandbox-admin and native-continuity implementation path.
